description: This Java class defines the RetrieveConnectionMetricsStrategy, a strategy handling the RetrieveConnectionMetrics command within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging persistence layer. It extends AbstractSingleActionStrategy and provides specific behavior for retrieving connection metrics.
